guidance.heading: Updated Full-Year 2026 Guidance*
section: •Adjusted Expenses: $1,155 - 1,175 million (trending towards the middle of the range)
•Acquisition and Refinitiv Transaction related depreciation and amortization expense: $160 million
•Cash capital expenditures and capitalized software development: ~$107 - 117 million

The adjusted expense guidance has been revised to reflect the year-to-date revenue growth coupled with our current expectations for the remainder of the year. Depreciation and amortization, assumed non-GAAP tax rate, expenditures and LSEG Market Data Contract Revenue guidance is unchanged from the guidance we provided last quarter.

*GAAP operating expenses and tax rate guidance are not provided due to the inherent difficulty in quantifying certain amounts due to a variety of factors including the unpredictability in the movement of foreign currency rates. Expense guidance assumes an average 2026 Sterling/US$ foreign exchange rate of 1.32. Our updated full-year 2026 guidance does not incorporate the impact of any potential strategic acquisitions that have been announced by us but not yet closed.
